--- display_header ---
void display() {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -9.0000f);
  glRotatef(25.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  static float n, p, q, ang, rr, x, y, z; // samples, winds, angle, ring radius, coords
  glClearColor(0.05, 0.05, 0.08, 1);
  glLineWidth(2);
  n = 400; // samples around the closed curve
  p = 2; // turns around the torus axis
  q = 3; // turns through the torus hole
  glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
    for(i, 0, n) {
      ang = TAU * i/n;
      rr = 2.0 + cos(q*ang); // distance from the axis
      x = rr * cos(p*ang);
      y = rr * sin(p*ang);
      z = sin(q*ang);
      glColor3f(0.5 + 0.5*sin(ang + t), 0.5 + 0.5*sin(ang + t + 2.0), 0.5 + 0.5*sin(ang + t + 4.0));
      glVertex3f(x, y, z);
    }
  glEnd();
